title: Show the power profile OSD when the profile is changed outside Plasma, e.g. by a laptop's Fn key
line: Switching the power profile with a laptop's profile key or another tool now shows the same on-screen indicator as Plasma's own shortcut.
explanation: PowerDevil only called the power profile OSD from setProfile() when Plasma's own shortcut (Meta+B / Battery key) cycled the profile. Changes made by the firmware profile key, powerprofilesctl or other tools reach PowerDevil only as an ActiveProfile change from power-profiles-daemon, which just updated the tray. PowerDevil now remembers the profile it requested itself and, for any other ActiveProfile change, shows the OSD after 500 ms if the profile still differs from the one before; changes that come with a profile-hold change (gamemode, apps holding a profile) and the initial read at startup stay silent.

commits.message:
daemon/powerprofile: show the OSD when the profile changes externally

The power profile OSD only appeared for Plasma's own shortcut, so a switch
made by a laptop's profile key or another tool went unnoticed. Changes not
requested by PowerDevil or caused by profile holds now show it, debounced.

BUG: 526165

media.caption: Profile changed to Performance directly on power-profiles-daemon (like the firmware key): no indicator
Same external change to Power Save with the fix: the power profile OSD appears
